temporal.definition: First correct anchor after true boundary, before end of that segment. False switch: prediction change between anchors with same true label. No sequence correction.

early_false_switch.definition: Successor-stage prediction bursts during the immediately preceding true segment, including transient and sustained errors

temporal.wrong_duration_definition: Anchor-label rectangle estimate: each raw argmax held until next anchor/end; 2 Hz resolution, no smoothing

anticipation.definition: Alerts differ from oracle true current stage; supported only by a matching true transition within the fixed horizon. Multiple-boundary events are explicitly ambiguous; no online decision uses truth.

oracle_current_persistence.definition: Oracle true current stage held as future prediction; hard labels, no probabilistic NLL

anticipation.ambiguity_rule: Events with another boundary less than horizon away are excluded from recall, retained explicitly
